Plot QC cutoff effects

Source: R/qc_runner.R
plot_qc_cutoffs.Rd

Show how different QC cutoff values affect the proportion of spots and genes that would be removed.

Usage

plot_qc_cutoffs(
  spe,
  library_cutoff = NULL,
  gene_cutoff = NULL,
  n_points = 200,
  theme_name = "classic"
)

Arguments

spe

A SpatialExperiment object containing QC metrics generated by `add_qcs()`.

library_cutoff

Optional selected cutoff for log library size.

gene_cutoff

Optional selected cutoff for log mean gene expression.

n_points

Number of cutoff values used to construct each curve. Default is 200.

theme_name

Plot theme. One of `"classic"`, `"bw"`, `"minimal"`, or `"gray"`.

Value

A list containing cutoff data and plot.

Details

No filtering is performed by this function.

Examples

data(spe_example)

spe_qc <- add_qcs(
  spe_example,
  assay_name = "counts",
  mito_pattern = "^MT-"
)

ls <- c(100, 200)
gc <- c(20, 50)

p <- lapply(seq_len(2), function(i) {
  p_cutoffs <- plot_qc_cutoffs(
    spe_qc,
    library_cutoff = ls[i],
    gene_cutoff = gc[i],
    n_points = 200,
    theme_name = "classic"
  )

  p_cutoffs$plot
})

patchwork::wrap_plots(p, ncol = 1) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
